read_first: **The lending service's development host runs an earlier build.** Changes to the lending service merged after 9 March are listed under Coming next and become testable with the next deploy. The catalogue website deploys on every merge and is current.

items.title: Book pages show how many copies are on the shelf
items.engineering_title: availability: show the on-shelf copy count per branch on the book page
items.what_changed: Each book page now says how many copies are on the shelf at each branch. Before this, it only said whether the library owned the book.
items.why: Readers can tell whether a trip to a branch is worth it before they set out, and branch staff answer fewer calls asking the same thing.
items.where: Development, https://catalogue.example.test, then any book's page
steps: Open https://catalogue.example.test in a browser. You do not need to sign in.
Search for any title and open its page.
items.expect: An Availability panel that lists each branch with the number of copies on its shelf, for example 2 on the shelf.
items.evidence: GET https://catalogue.example.test/books/1001 signed out returned 200 with an Availability panel listing three branches

items.title: Members can renew a loan from their account page
items.engineering_title: loans: renew from the account page and the loans tab
items.what_changed: A Renew button sits beside each loan on a member's account page. Before this, members could renew only at a branch desk.
items.why: Members keep a book longer without contacting a branch, and desk staff spend less time on routine renewals.
items.where: Development, https://catalogue.example.test, My account, then Loans
steps: Sign in to https://catalogue.example.test as a test member with books on loan.
Press Renew beside a loan and confirm.
Reload the page and check the new due date.
Press Renew on a loan that has reached its renewal limit; the page should refuse it.
items.expect: After you confirm and reload, the loan shows a due date three weeks later. A loan at its renewal limit is refused, and the page says why before anything is sent.
items.access: A test member sign-in with books on loan, one of them at its renewal limit
items.screen_note: The Loans table on the account page, with a Renew button beside each loan.
items.evidence: Catalogue build 4e5f6a7 contains the merge commit; the screen needs a sign-in, so it was not observed.

items.title: Members can join the waiting list for a book that is out
items.what_changed: A new route lets a signed-in member join the waiting list for a book whose copies are all on loan, and serves the list in the order members joined.
items.test_later: Development, after the next lending service deploy

items.title: The reader app opens a book's page from its barcode
items.what_changed: Pointing the phone's camera at the barcode on a book now opens that book's page in the app, with its shelf location at each branch.
items.test_later: A development build of the reader app, once one exists

items.title: Lending records are backed up every night
items.what_changed: Defines a nightly backup of the lending records, kept for thirty days, so records lost to a mistake can be restored. It does not exist until applied.
